lines_of_business: EmblemHealth plans (and ConnectiCare per revision history); benefit program governs; mentions Medicare and Medicaid mandates in the disclaimer
criteria_location: 'Guideline' and 'Documentation' on pp.2-3: a list of acceptable indications (explicitly 'not meant to be all-inclusive') followed by photograph and visual-field measurements. About 6 of 11 pages are an ICD-10 list (H01-H02, L11, L57.4, Q10, Q11, Z90.01).

logic.top_level: any (a non-exhaustive list of covered indications) plus a separate all-of documentation block
logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Limitations: 'solely for cosmetic reasons' and 'cosmetic ... in the absence of any signs or symptoms of functional abnormalities'; no contraindication list.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Members are eligible for coverage of blepharoplasty procedures and repair of blepharoptosis when performed as functional or reconstructive surgery to correct any of the following (list not meant to be all-inclusive)
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: An open list: a condition not listed may still be covered, so 'not on the list' cannot be NOT_MET.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Photographs must demonstrate ≥ 1 of the following
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Documentation 'any of'; unclear whether it applies to every indication on the list or only ptosis-type ones (it says oblique photos 'only needed ... when this is the only indication').

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Ectropion and Entropion (visual fields not necessary)
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Inline exemption from the visual-field requirement for one list item, while the field requirement is stated later and not scoped.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Blepharoplasty, blepharoptosis repair, or brow lift and lower lid blepharoplasty is considered cosmetic ...
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Brow lift appears in the cosmetic exclusion, but no brow lift indication appears in the Guideline list; there are no brow-lift criteria.

requirement_kinds.quote: Congenital ptosis with risk for amblyopia; Ectropion and Entropion; Prosthesis difficulties in an anophthalmia socket; Epiblepharon; Lagophthalmos; Post-traumatic defects of the eyelid; Exposure keratopathy secondary to thyroid eye disease

The Plan does not consider blepharoplasty procedures performed solely for cosmetic reasons to be medically necessary
ICD-10 H01.xx blepharitis, H02.xx entropion/ectropion/trichiasis/lagophthalmos/ptosis, L57.4, Q10.x, Z90.01

codes.codes_tied_to_criteria: Listed without mapping; the ICD-10 list is long (about 180 rows) and includes blepharitis codes even though 'chronic blepharitis' as an indication was removed 1/2022.

vague_terms.quote: Visual impairment with near or far vision
should be restricted ... should be a minimum

extraction_hazards: About half the PDF is an ICD-10 table in a one-code-per-row layout with blank lines; it dominates extracted text.
Page footers 'Proprietary information of EmblemHealth' and 'Page x of 11' sit mid-table.
Bullets have no glyph in text; list items are indistinguishable from prose.
Typo 'The superior visual with the upper eyelid at rest' (missing 'field').
interesting_structures: Visual-field threshold lower than BCBSFL: improvement of only 12 degrees, with the lid at rest within 30 degrees of fixation.
Revision history documents indications removed (chronic blepharitis 2022; pretarsal dermatitis 2023) and added (epiblepharon, lagophthalmos, thyroid exposure).
No brow lift criteria at all though brow lift is in the code list.

fit_to_tree.why: Open lists and 'should' phrasing resist a closed tree; the ANY-of list is easy but 'list not meant to be all-inclusive' means a missing match cannot be treated as a failure.
